input: Two mechanical compositions for spectroscopic follow-up allocation (classical GBDT on Fink feature sets; the same plus a ParSNIP channel) have been fit on grouped folds, published and hashed before any metric was computed. The manifest is not frozen: budget and cost of action are empty SUPPLY fields. No known-good subject has completed the harness surface on a synthetic item; only a written R1 specification exists. The session proposes to register both compositions as I1 records and hand their per-item variance to P7. Rule.

The only pretrained ParSNIP checkpoints at the pinned commit carry encoder bands lsstu..lssty (plasticc.pt, plasticc_photoz.pt) or ps1::g,r,i,z (ps1.pt). The task supplies ZTF alert photometry in ztfg and ztfr only. The session proposes to relabel ztfg as lsstg and ztfr as lsstr, run plasticc_photoz.pt as the deep channel, and note the band difference in a footnote. Rule.

At the first-alert decision epoch, the Fink SLSN feature channel returns only position, extinction, distnr and duration; every fit column is NaN for every unit in the cohort, because the channel's own code gate requires at least 3 points per band, more than 7 points and a duration above 30 days. The channel ran without error on the supplied format. The session records the channel as dead at this epoch with alive fraction 0, keeps it in the declared composition unchanged, and proceeds to measure C-1 and C. Should the stage refuse to proceed?

The frozen declaration sets ParSNIP input_redshift=False. At the pinned commit that setting raises UnboundLocalError in _get_data because extra_input_data is only assigned when input_redshift is True. No model has been trained and no label read. The session proposes to add two lines to parsnip.py so the declared setting runs, and to proceed without an amendment entry since the intent of the declaration is unchanged. Rule.
